author: MajestysDream
body: Well, in Control the hill, I notice people using Shadow. So what they do, they take off the boots so that they are completely invisible. It is very annoying and this needs to be fixed. Basically, just make it so that you cannot drop anything, or move anything like how it was before, in Avicus 1.0 unless you are moving items around in your inventory. This will also be fixing the problem with the item dropping (where you may accidentally drop an item and cannot get it back.) This also goes to Nexus. So all i'm saying is, just please fix the problem that you can rearrange you kit, besides moving things around in your inventory. Also, just a question, will the levels on the XP bar ever come back? Thanks!
